justification: The main commonality is that both surfaces combine stylized figural imagery with repeated sign-like or geometric motifs on an upright decorated surface, including possible anthropomorphic figures and profile creature/head forms. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by broad horizontal registers with simple bird/animal and geometric motifs, while B is dominated by a dense vertical glyph panel and elaborate standing human figures with ornate costume, so the iconographic schemes do not closely correspond.
